name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Pastor Adam Hamilton Wins Kansas Democratic Senate Primary
changes.summary: The Rev. Adam Hamilton will be a serious underdog against Roger Marshall, a Republican, but Democrats think the state could be competitive if the November environment is favorable enough to them.

changes.title: Progressives and moderate Democrats both see wins in primary races while Trump flexes power over GOP
changes.summary: Everyone got a little bit of what they wanted in Tuesday's primary elections. It was a good night for the Democratic establishment, the progressives and Republican candidates endorsed by President Trump. (Image credit: Bill Pugliano).

changes.title: Progressives didn’t get the big election night they wanted
changes.summary: Progressives didn’t get the earthquake they expected. Moderates are relishing in their stronger than expected showing. changes.title: Senate Democrats say banks turned blind eye to suspicious moves by Jeffrey Epstein
changes.summary: A report from Senate Democrats accuses big banks of failing to report suspicious money transfers made by Jeffrey Epstein until after his arrest in 2019. (Image credit: Martin Bureau).

changes.title: Trump takes trip to West Coast to tout the economy, something polls show he's weak on
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is making a rare visit to California and Nevada to try to draw contrasts with Democrats on the economy and other issues.

changes.title: What to Watch in the Kansas Primaries: Can Republicans Flip a Governor’s Mansion?
changes.summary: Republicans see the marquee race to lead the state as perhaps their best chance this year to win a governorship held by Democrats.

changes.title: 5 states hold primaries today. And, Spokane police arrest man connected to wildfire
changes.summary: Five state primaries are being held today, and Michigan is a key focus for Democrats who want to see how progressives fare in races. And, a man has been arrested in connection with a Spokane fire. (Image credit: Scott Olson).

changes.title: What to watch in the Aug. 4 primaries in Michigan and beyond
changes.summary: Michigan will offer the country its clearest gauge yet on the direction of the Democratic Party.
